variety_description: High yielding, medium maturity, medium tall, medium slender variety suitable for cultivation under rainfed lowland conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 2008 for planting in Bangladesh in Aman season. Photo insensitive, Lodging tolerant. Susceptible to false smut.
